column1: # Условие без if, сослагательное наклонение и wish.

column2: Had we known earlier, we would have acted.
Were she here, she would help us.
Should you see him, tell him to call.
I have known him for years.
It is important that he be present.
I suggest that she go alone.
The doctor insisted that she take the medicine.
It is important that he arrives on time.
It is important to arrive on time.
I wish I knew the answer.
If only I had more time!
She wishes she had studied harder.
If only I had known earlier!
I wish you would stop smoking.
I wish he would write more often.

column1: # Простое пожелание без глагольной цепочки — не наклонение.

column2: We wish you a merry Christmas.
I wish you luck in the new job.
